scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:protocol && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:plugin: tsc -p packages/plugin/tsconfig.build.json && esbuild packages/plugin/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:obsidian --outfile=packages/plugin/dist/main.js && node scripts/package-plugin.mjs
scripts.build:runtime: esbuild packages/runtime/src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=packages/runtime/dist/cli.js && esbuild packages/runtime/src/state-store.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=packages/runtime/dist/state-store.js && esbuild packages/runtime/src/web-read.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=packages/runtime/dist/web-read.js && esbuild packages/runtime/src/capability-gated-provider.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=packages/runtime/dist/capability-gated-provider.js
